description: The one result object the message and peers tools return when a surface routes through the shared router: snake_case keys, the contract field set, and the same nesting for peers list, rename and last. A consumer's test builds the same provider outcome and asserts its structured result equals the entry here, so two surfaces cannot return different shapes for one result. 'error' is the shared tool-error object. Keys are absent exactly when the corresponding fact is absent, matching internal/messaging/router Result.Output and ToolError.Output.
